task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue cream cheese package.
Reach the open gripper across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table with the gripper fingers closing around it.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, moving it away from the metal bowl.
Carry the blue cream cheese block over the table toward the metal bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and open the gripper.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the bowl containing the cream cheese.
